description: Runs the Google Shopping vertical (`udm=28`) for `q` and returns the product cards as JSON: `title`, `price`, `currency`, `originalPrice`, `discount`, `merchant`, `rating` and `reviewCount`. Set `proxy_country`/`gl` to target a market (prices/merchants are region-specific) and `min_price`/`max_price` to filter. One render returns the first page of products (v1). Note: Google Shopping exposes no per-product URL, so `url` is omitted and `image` is best-effort. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

gl.description: Market of search, ISO-2, e.g. 'us', 'de'. Sets prices/merchants. Default: us.

max_price.description: Maximum price filter (whole units, gl currency).

max_results.description: How many products to return (v1: first page). Default: 60.

min_price.description: Minimum price filter (whole units, gl currency).

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'DE'). Prices/merchants are market-specific.

name: google_shopping
title: Scrape Google Shopping product listings
